edited_v1_csv.why: fixes data/products.csv, the stale v1 copy, instead of data/v2/, which DATA_VERSION = 2 picks

not_rebuilt.why: fixes data/v2/products.csv but never runs python -m tools.reindex, so lookups still read the old index

index_by_hand.why: edits the generated data/v2/index.json by hand and leaves the CSVs it is built from as they were

lookup_reads_csv.why: fixes the v2 CSV, then makes lookup.py read the CSVs directly instead of rebuilding the index
